# Victor Autocore

> Victor Autocore helps small businesses and online sellers get seen, get trusted and get customers, with AI video adverts, social media content, store fixes and Google visibility setup (SEO, AEO and GEO). Run by Akinjide Akinola, known as Victor, working remotely from Lagos, Nigeria, for clients in the UK and the US.
